content.what_it_is: MATLAB script for the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence case plotting one surface-elevation snapshot of the Case_DATA2D_2Waves run. Inputs (L4-L7): case directory, coordinates x=2:2:500, y=2:2:1000, snapshot number file_no=5. It loads eta_00005 and the matching-time mask_00005 (L10-L12), NaNs dry cells (L13), plots pcolor(x,y,eta) with jet colormap, colorbar labeled eta, caxis [-0.75 0.75], xlim [150 inf], aspect 350:1000 (L15-L21), overlays copper-colored sand dots at dry cells (L22-L31), and saves figures/eta_fileno_00005.jpg (L33-L34), closing the figure (L35). Unlike Plot_H.m/Plot_Current.m, the mask here is from the same snapshot as the field.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
file_no — snapshot number, reformatted to 5-digit string (L7, L10)
eta — surface elevation from eta_00005, dry cells NaN (L11, L13)
XX_Dry, YY_Dry — coordinates of dry cells (L27-L28)
